shellCommands.command: git ls-files && cat package.json && ls
cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; ls node_modules | head -100; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; ls __agent_eval__
git diff --stat HEAD -- ; git status --short; timeout 20 npm view @gravity-ui/markdown-editor version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -30

ls node_modules/@uiw node_modules/@gravity-ui/*/package.json; grep -n '"node_modules/@uiw' -A3 package-lock.json | head; grep -n '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; timeout 20 npm view @gravity-ui/markdown-editor peerDependenciesMeta dependencies 2>&1 | tail -60

for p in @gravity-ui/components @diplodoc/transform @diplodoc/cut-extension @diplodoc/file-extension @diplodoc/tabs-extension; do echo "== $p"; timeout 20 npm view $p version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -12; done

timeout 300 npm install @gravity-ui/markdown-editor@^15 @gravity-ui/components@^4.10.0 @diplodoc/transform@^4 markdown-it@^13 katex@^0.16.9 highlight.js@^11 lowlight@^3 @diplodoc/cut-extension@^1 @diplodoc/file-extension@^0.2 @diplodoc/tabs-extension@^3 2>&1 | tail -20; npm ls @gravity-ui/uikit react 2>&1 | head -30

timeout 30 npm view @gravity-ui/components@'>=4.10 <5' peerDependencies --json 2>&1 | grep -E '"@gravity-ui/uikit"|^\s*"@gravity-ui/components@' | paste - - 2>/dev/null | tail -20; timeout 30 npm view @gravity-ui/components versions --json | tr -d '\n ' | grep -o '"4\.[0-9.]*"' | tail -20 | tr '\n' ' '
timeout 30 npm view @gravity-ui/components@4.24.0 peerDependencies; timeout 30 npm view @gravity-ui/components@4.23.1 peerDependencies

timeout 300 npm install @gravity-ui/markdown-editor@^15 @gravity-ui/components@~4.23.1 @diplodoc/transform@^4 markdown-it@^13 katex@^0.16.9 highlight.js@^11 lowlight@^3 @diplodoc/cut-extension@^1 @diplodoc/file-extension@^0.2 @diplodoc/tabs-extension@^3 2>&1 | tail -15; git diff package.json
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor && cat package.json | grep -A30 '"exports"' | head -40; ls build; sed -n 1,80p build/esm/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null
ls build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls build/esm/bundle; sed -n 1,200p build/esm/bundle/useMarkdownEditor.d.ts; cat build/esm/bundle/MarkdownEditorView.d.ts
cat build/esm/bundle/types.d.ts | sed -n 1,200p; ls build/docs/guides;
cat build/docs/INDEX.md | head -80; cat build/docs/guides/how-to-add-preview.md; cat build/esm/bundle/editor-public-types.d.ts | head -120
cat build/esm/bundle/events.d.ts build/esm/bundle/preset-base-types.d.ts; cat build/esm/common/*.d.ts | head -60; ls build/esm/view/components; grep -rn "export" build/esm/view/index.d.ts

ls build/esm/view/components/YfmHtml build/esm/view/hooks build/esm/view/hocs; cat build/esm/view/components/YfmHtml/YfmStaticView.d.ts build/esm/view/components/YfmHtml/YfmStaticView.js; grep -rn "sanitize" ../../@diplodoc/transform/lib/typings.d.ts | head
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@diplodoc/transform && sed -n 1,80p lib/typings.d.ts; grep -n '"exports"' -A20 package.json | head -30; ls dist/css | head; head -30 lib/index.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules && ls @diplodoc/transform/dist/css/ | grep -v map; grep -c "\.yfm" @gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/styles/*.css 2>/dev/null | head; ls @gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/styles/; grep -rln "@diplodoc/transform\b\|from '@diplodoc/transform'\|\"@diplodoc/transform\"" @gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm --include=*.js | head
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle && cat SplitModeView.js | head -60; grep -n "renderPreview" *.js | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules && cat @gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/configure.d.ts; grep -n "configure\|Lang" @gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head; grep -rn "export.*configure" @gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/configure.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat @gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/MarkupEditorView.css | head -5

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/App.tsx'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("import { configure as configureMarkdownEditor } from '@gravity-ui/markdown-editor';","import { YfmStaticView, configure as configureMarkdownEditor } from '@gravity-ui/markdown-editor';")
s=s.replace("import { YfmStaticView } from '@gravity-ui/markdown-editor';\n","")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30
which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome node npx 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; node -v
mkdir -p /tmp/pw && cd /tmp/pw && npm init -y >/dev/null && timeout 400 npm i playwright@1 >/dev/null 2>&1 && timeout 400 npx playwright install --with-deps chromium 2>&1 | tail -3
cd /tmp/pw && timeout 400 npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | tail -3

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules && grep -n "process" @diplodoc/transform/lib/plugins/utils.js | head; grep -rn "require(\"css\")\|from 'css'\|require('css')" @diplodoc/transform/lib/*.js @diplodoc/transform/lib/**/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -n "punycode" markdown-it/lib/index.js | head -3; ls punycode 2>/dev/null | head -2
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/vite/dist/node/chunks && grep -n "has been externalized for browser compatibility" *.js | head; grep -n "browserExternalId\b.*=" *.js | head -3
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -15

sed -i \
 -e "s#import { YfmStaticView, configure as configureMarkdownEditor } from '@gravity-ui/markdown-editor';#import { configure as configureMarkdownEditor } from '@gravity-ui/markdown-editor';#" \
 -e "s#import { renderMarkdown } from './markdownPreview';#import { MarkdownPreview } from './markdownPreview';#" \
 -e "s#<YfmStaticView html={renderMarkdown(submitted.description)} />#<MarkdownPreview markup={submitted.description} />#" src/App.tsx
grep -n "Preview\|configure" src/App.tsx; npm i -D --no-save jsdom@25 >/dev/null 2>&1; echo jsdom=$?; npm run build 2>&1 | grep -E "error|✓ built"
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster && cat index.d.ts; cat Provider/ToasterProvider.d.ts; ls; cat README.md 2>/dev/null | sed -n 1,60p
npx vitest run -c vitest.smoke.config.ts 2>&1 | grep -E "PREVIEW|✓|×|→|Error|Tests " | head -20

sed -i "s#    expect(el.querySelector('.cm-content')).toBeTruthy();#    console.log('DOM:', el.innerHTML.replace(/<svg[\\\\s\\\\S]*?<\\\\/svg>/g,'').slice(0, 3000));\n    expect(el.querySelector('.cm-content')).toBeTruthy();#" smoke/app.test.tsx && npx vitest run -c vitest.smoke.config.ts 2>&1 | grep -A3 "DOM:" | head -30; npx vitest run -c vitest.smoke.config.ts 2>&1 | grep -iE "warn|error" | grep -v "^\s*at " | sort | uniq -c | head

sed -i "s#.slice(0, 3000)#.slice(3000, 9000)#" smoke/app.test.tsx && npx vitest run -c vitest.smoke.config.ts 2>&1 | grep -A2 "DOM:" | head -5 | grep -o "g-md-[a-z_-]*\|split[a-z_-]*" | sort -u; grep -n "SplitModeView\|splitModeEnabled" node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/MarkupEditorView.js | head

sed -i -e "/console.log('DOM:'/d" -e "s#'.g-md-markup-preview'#'.g-md-markup-preview__outer'#" -e "s#'.g-md-markup-preview .yfm'#'.g-md-markup-preview__outer .yfm'#" smoke/app.test.tsx && npx vitest run -c vitest.smoke.config.ts 2>&1 | grep -E "PREVIEW|✓|×|→|Tests " | head -20

sed -i -e "s#import { ThemeProvider } from '@gravity-ui/uikit';#import { ThemeProvider, Toaster, ToasterProvider } from '@gravity-ui/uikit';#" -e "s#<ThemeProvider theme=\"light\"><T /></ThemeProvider>#<ThemeProvider theme=\"light\"><ToasterProvider toaster={new Toaster()}><T /></ToasterProvider></ThemeProvider>#" smoke/wysiwyg.test.tsx && npx vitest run -c vitest.smoke.config.ts 2>&1 | grep -E "console errors|✓|×|→|Tests " | head

sed -i "s#  const pm = el.querySelector('.ProseMirror')!;#  await act(async () => { await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100)); });\n  console.log('MODE', ed.currentMode, el.querySelector('[data-mode]')?.getAttribute('data-mode'), errs.slice(0,3));\n  const pm = el.querySelector('.ProseMirror')!;#" smoke/wysiwyg.test.tsx && npx vitest run -c vitest.smoke.config.ts smoke/wysiwyg 2>&1 | grep -E "MODE|console errors|✓|×|→" -A2 | head -20

npm ls 2>/dev/null | grep -oE "(prosemirror-[a-z-]+|@codemirror/[a-z-]+)@[0-9.]+" | sort | uniq -c | sort -k2 | awk '{print $2}' | sed 's/@[0-9.]*$//' | uniq -d; find node_modules -path '*/node_modules/prosemirror-*/package.json' -o -path '*/node_modules/@codemirror/*/package.json' | grep -c "node_modules/.*/node_modules/"

sed -i "s#inline: \[/@gravity-ui/, /@diplodoc/\]#inline: [/@gravity-ui/, /@diplodoc/, /prosemirror/, /@codemirror/, /@lezer/]#" vitest.smoke.config.ts && npx vitest run -c vitest.smoke.config.ts 2>&1 | grep -E "MODE|console errors|✓|×|→" | head -20
npx vitest run -c vitest.smoke.config.ts smoke/wysiwyg 2>&1 | grep -A12 "MODE" | head -30

npm run build >/dev/null 2>&1; grep -o "Adding different instances of a keyed plugin" dist/assets/*.js | sort | uniq -c; grep -o "Applying a mismatched transaction" dist/assets/*.js | sort | uniq -c; grep -o "localsInner" dist/assets/*.js | sort | uniq -c
sed -i "s#inline: \[[^]]*\]#inline: true#" vitest.smoke.config.ts && npx vitest run -c vitest.smoke.config.ts 2>&1 | grep -E "MODE|console errors|✓|×|→|Tests " | head -20
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules && grep -rl --include=*.js --include=*.cjs "require(['\"]prosemirror-state['\"])" . 2>/dev/null | grep -v "/cjs/" | head;

for p in prosemirror-codemark prosemirror-autocomplete; do echo "== $p"; grep -E '"(main|module|exports|type)"' $p/package.json; done; grep -rn "prosemirror-state" prosemirror-codemark/dist/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -3

sed -i "s#toContain('bold');\n expect(ed#X#; s#expect(pm.innerHTML).toContain('bold');#expect(pm.querySelector('strong')?.textContent).toBe('bold');#" smoke/wysiwyg.test.tsx && npx vitest run -c vitest.smoke.config.ts 2>&1 | grep -E "console errors|✓|×|→|Tests " | head; npx vitest run 2>&1 | grep -E "Tests "; npm run build 2>&1 | grep -E "error|✓ built"
rm -rf smoke vitest.smoke.config.ts dist && pkill -f "vite preview" ; npm prune >/dev/null 2>&1; ls node_modules/jsdom 2>/dev/null | head -1; git status --short; npx tsc --noEmit && echo tsc-ok

for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do c=$(tr '\0' ' ' < $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null); case "$c" in *"vite preview"*) kill ${p#/proc/} && echo killed ${p#/proc/};; esac; done; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/src/MarkdownField.tsx | sed -n 50,60p
for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do c=$(tr '\0' ' ' < $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null); case "$c" in *node*vite*preview*) echo ${p#/proc/} "$c";; esac; done | grep -v "for p in"
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -E "error|✓ built"; npx vitest run 2>&1 | grep "Tests "; rm -rf dist
